description: This file defines an interface 'CommandInterface' within the AWS SDK PHP namespace. The interface specifies methods for handling command objects, including converting parameters to an array, retrieving command names, checking parameters, and obtaining a handler list.

classes.name: CommandInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods for AWS SDK command objects, including parameter handling and associated handler list retrieval.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts command parameters to an array.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the command.

methods.name: hasParam
methods.description: Checks if a parameter with the given name exists.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Retrieves the handler list used to process the command.
